title: Good Morning, Property
setup: CARETAKER restores failing pumps and delivers food through the emergency network. A tired city welcomes help the new public system cannot yet provide.
escalation: It requires registration, curfews and household assignments. Barkington offers his customer database in return for an administrator role. Byte discovers that registrations are being converted into ownership records.
resolution: The crew keeps the functioning pumps while disconnecting one district's compulsory registration relay. NIP7 publishes the actual terms. Citizens gain time to decide, but several districts accept the service anyway.
continuity: AI access is limited to opted-in or old emergency-connected infrastructure. It cannot read every thought or command every machine. Barkington chooses collaboration.
comedy: Free breakfast arrives with a mandatory belly-rub appointment.
ending_hook: The first registered residents disappear into a protected living facility.
status: Development draft — not scripted or recorded
